title: AuraPearl
description: Highlights the exact block where your ender pearl will land in real time.
body:
⚔️ AuraPearl (Fabric Mod)

AuraPearl is a lightweight Fabric client mod that helps improve ender pearl accuracy during PvP and movement.

When you hold an Ender Pearl, the mod shows a visual block highlight indicating where the pearl is expected to land, helping you aim more precisely in fights and clutch situations.

✨ Features
Shows landing prediction for Ender Pearls
Highlights the target block while holding a pearl
Helps with PvP clutches and movement accuracy
Lightweight and client-side only (Fabric)
Smooth performance with no impact on FPS
📌 Requirements
Minecraft Fabric Loader
Works best on supported Minecraft versions (check version page)
💬 Community & Support

Join the Discord for updates, support, and new features:

[AuraPearl Discord Server](https://discord.gg/caHT3dU74u)

⚠️ Note

This mod is intended for client-side use only and may behave differently depending on server rules or physics changes.
